recommendation.title: Небо и Погода как описательные теги региона
recommendation.priority_reason: Completes two source-backed nature prompts directly useful when preparing a place; existing owner/resolver/history reused. NPC/combat/domain candidates require new state/context; myth procedures need heterogeneous schema audit.
recommendation.user_before_after: До: регион хранит Землю/Флору/Фауну, не позволяет сохранить бросок Неба/Погоды. После предлагаемого среза: можно получить пару описаний у региона и сохранить либо перебросить один компонент; география и течение времени не меняются.
recommendation.scope: Two optional descriptive tables on existing region owner; preserve compact inline UI, RNG counters, overrides and save/history. Values are descriptive snapshots selected by GM, not calculated climate.
recommendation.estimate: S–M: extend existing definitions/policy, UI and lifecycle; estimate not subscription consumption
dependencies: Suitable bounded specification and visible desktop/narrow proposal
Exact RU source rows and explicit EN fallback/translation policy
Fresh check of baseline when implementation starts
acceptance_outline: Both tables use two independent d12 slots, not sum or product lookup
On-demand only; opening card/import/mode switch does not roll; one-region owner and exact independent reroll

No automatic time/state/terrain mutation; old saves remain unchanged on load
Compact current UI reused; native keyboard and narrow layout checked; physical limitations recorded
